explanation: SJF can lead to starvation if a continuous stream of short processes keeps arriving, preventing longer processes from executing.
All four Coffman conditions must hold simultaneously for a deadlock to occur.
P1 runs from 0 to 5. P2 runs from 5 to 14. P2's completion time is 14. Turnaround Time = Completion - Arrival = 14 - 0 = 14.
